# Sound list

Every sound the game can use. Drop the file under `assets/sound/` and add `'sound/<name>.m4a'` (AAC is recommended; `.mp3 .aac .ogg .wav` also load) to `assets/assets.js`. The 43 names below may sit directly in `sound/` or in the catalog sub-folders (`sound/sfx/player/<name>.m4a`: the name is the file name, the folder only decides the load bank); the full 2,300-file tree is `docs/SOUND_DESIGN.md`. Anything missing stays synthesized (sfx, ambience) or silent (music). Volumes: settings sfxVolume / ambienceVolume / musicVolume.

**43 files, 0 hand-made so far.** Generated by `tests/assets.html` from the game code on 2026-10-15 — do not edit by hand; re-run the page.

| Section | Files | Done |
|---|---|---|
| Sound effects | 25 | 0 |
| Ambience beds | 9 | 0 |
| Music | 9 | 0 |
